references.text: The Lord's sword that punishes, a flashing sword that brings judgment upon the enemies
The Lord's sword drunk with blood, his vengeance against the enemies
A flashing sword sharpened for slaughter, God's judgment on the ungodly
The sword is drawn to slay, a flashing sword that brings judgment
The Lord takes vengeance on his adversaries and holds fast to wrath against his enemies
God sharpens his sword and draws his bow against the pursuers
The God of vengeance who repays the proud with what they deserve
Vengeance belongs to the Lord; he will repay in due time
From his mouth comes a sharp sword with which he strikes down the nations, and he rules them with an iron scepter
The Lord will judge his people; vengeance is his, and he will repay
